title: Multidisciplinary Arts, Social Sciences, Sciences, and Humanities, B.A. (Behrend)
notes: Pattern B by definition -- an individualized/self-designed degree unique to Behrend's School of Humanities and Social Sciences, with no University Park equivalent. Real structure confirmed via the bulletin: 120cr minimum, split GenEd 45cr + Major 36cr + BA Degree Requirements 24cr + Electives 15cr. The Major (36cr) is a real, enforceable structure even though it's individualized: a 12cr Common Foundation (3cr in EACH of four knowledge areas -- Arts, Humanities, Science/Mathematics, Social and Behavioral Sciences -- modeled here as 4 slots tagged to the closest matching GenEd domain for recommendation purposes) plus a 24cr Specialized Option chosen from 5 real bulletin-named options (Arts, Humanities, Science/Mathematics, Social and Behavioral Sciences, or an adviser-approved Liberal Studies option drawing from 'any B.A. course offering'). Since a concrete plan has to pick one to be schedulable, this plan models the Humanities option (24cr, min. 15cr at 400-level per the bulletin's own rule -- 5 of this plan's 8 Specialized Option slots are labeled 400-level to satisfy that; the remaining 3 are open-level) as generic slots -- this is a genuinely open, adviser/student-designed pool by the program's own design (not a data gap the way an unenumerated elective category is for other majors), so there is no enumerable real course list to cite here the way there is for e.g. a department's required courses. A real student choosing a different one of the 5 options, or the Liberal Studies option specifically, would need a different, individually-approved course list -- that per-student variability is the actual nature of this major and can't be reduced to one canonical schedule beyond what's modeled here. BA Degree Requirements (24cr: World Language through Level 3 = 12cr, 3 BA Field courses = 9cr, World Cultures = 3cr) and 5 general Elective slots (15cr) round out the plan alongside 45cr of GenEd (modeled generically). NOT modeled (this engine has no GPA/credit-count gating): the real declaration requirements (2.0 cumulative GPA, third-semester/30+-credit standing before declaring this major). Plan totals 118.5cr, close to the bulletin's 120cr minimum.
